paite: Nang loh tuak ngei lou pi-a, aloka pang, lepchiah taka bawl tuak ngeilou pi-a, lepchiah taka pang, na tung a gik hi, Mi loh na tuak sam ding hi; lepchiah taka na hih khit chianain, na tungah lepchiah takin a hih ding uh.
english: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed; and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have made an end of betrayal, you will be betrayed.

paite: Toupa aw, hon hehpihin; ka hon ngak nilouh uhi; jingsang tengin a ban uh honghi inla, buai hun chiangin leng hon hondampa honghi in.
english: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

paite: Lum vengvung husain mi chih a taimang ta ua; nang na kisak hial chiangin nam chih hihdalhin a omta uh.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

paite: Na sum uh gallaka lak ding lungin thil a kaihkhawmin a om ding; khaupete a tawm duamduam uh bangin amaute tuh sum tungah a tawm duamduam ding uh.
english: Your spoil will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

paite: Toupa tawisangin a omta; tunglamah lah a om ngala; aman Zion lah vaihawm diktakna leh diktatnain a dimsak ta hi.
english: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

paite: Na dam sungin om kipna a om dinga. hotdamnate, pilnate, theihna te a om kikeih ding; TOUPA launa lah a gou ahi a.
english: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.

paite: Ngaiin, a pasalphate uh polamah a kikou ua; kituahna palaite lah a kap hohhoh uhi.
english: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

paite: Lamliante lah a mualta ua, mi zin vialvakte lah a om nawn kei uh; amah lah thukhun a bohsiaa, khuate lah a musita, mi khawk a sa ta kei.
english: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

paite: Gam lah a kapin a gima; Lebanon tuh a zumin a vuaia; Sharon lah gamdai bang a hita; Bashan leh Karmelin a nah uh a sing khia uh.
english: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

paite: TOUPAN, Tun ka thou dinga, tun ka kisa dinga, tun tawi sangin ka omta ding.
english: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh; “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

paite: Lou keu na pai ding ua, buhpawl na suang ding uh; na hu uh noumau kang mang ding mei ahi.
english: You will conceive chaff. You will bring forth stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

paite: Mi chih lah chinai suang hal bang, loulingnei vat sa meia a paih bang uh, a chi ding uh, a chi a.
english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

paite: Gamlapi-a omte aw, ka thil hih bilin na ja un; naichika omte aw, ka thilhihtheihdan thei un.
english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

paite: Ziona mi gilou omten a lau ua; Pathian zahlou mite linnain a manta hi. I lak ua kua ahia thil kat mang ching mei kianga om ding? i lak uah kua ahia khantawna kang zoizoi kianga om ding?
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

paite: Diktattaka oma diktaka gen jelmi; nuaisiahnate punna himhim bangmaha ngailou-a golhna la nuamlou-a bil huma, gilou himhim en nuamlou-a mitsi jel mi;
english: He who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; He who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

paite: Huai mi bel tunglamah a om dinga; a kidalna mun sang lah suangpi kidalnate ahi ding; a an lah a kianga piak ahi dinga, a tuite lah a om ngeingei ding.
english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

paite: Na miten kumpipa lah a kilawmnain a mu dinga, gam kiphalh za tak a hon en ding uhi.
english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

paite: A simmi koia omta ahia? siahliau tehmi koia omta ahia? galven insangte simmi koia omta ahia? chiin, na lungtangin thil mulkimhuai mahmah na ngaihtuah ding.
english: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

paite: Mi hangtak, pau giltak na theihtheih louha pau mite, pau tuam na theihsiam louha pau mite, na mu nawnta kei ding.
english: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

paite: I zehtanna khopi Zion en dih; na mitin Jerusalem omna muanhuaitak, puanin chikchianga leng suan louh ding, kaih gakna khet chik chiang aleng boh louh ding, a kaihna khau himhim kitat lou ding bang, a mu ding.
english: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

paite: Huailaiah TOUPA, lui za pipi leh luitate omna mun, thupitakin i kiang uah a omzo ta ding; huai tui tungah kidouna long lianpi kalhna chiang neite himhim a pai kei dinga, long lian thupitak inleng a khen sam kei ding hi.
english: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

paite: TOUPA lah i vaihawmpa ahi a, TOUPA lah dan hon pepa ahi a, TOUPA lah i kumpipa ahi; aman a honhondam ding hi.
english: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.

paite: Na khaute tuh kolsakin a om dinga; a puanjak peu bul uh lah a kipsak theikei ua, puanjak lah a jak theikei uh; huai laitakin gallak sum tampi hawmin a oma; khebaiten leng gallak sum a lata uhi.Huai khuaa mi omin, ka chi a na, chi kei dinga, a sunga mite tuh khelh ngaihdamin a om ding uhi.
english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great spoil was divided. The lame took the prey.

paite: Huai khuaa mi omin, ka chi a na, chi kei dinga, a sunga mite tuh khelh ngaihdamin a om ding uhi.
english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
